task: Remove the unused Istio reader RBAC and the Alloy logs cluster-wide Secret read (CIS 5.1.2 KSV041, 5.1.3 KSV046), RBAC batch P3 + P4

events.summary: P3 and P4 only: istio-reader ClusterRole/Binding/ServiceAccount via global.enableReaderRBAC on istio-base and istiod, and the Secret verbs of the k8s-monitoring-alloy-logs ClusterRole via collectors.alloy-logs.rbac.rules, each in the GitOps Application and the bootstrap script. The k8s-monitoring-alloy-operator ClusterRole Secret verbs are a different rule and were left alone.

Before the change the pinned charts render the objects and the live ClusterRole matches the render. Read-only live checks found no consumer of the istio reader and no Secret use in the Alloy logs configuration.
evidence: test:helm template istiod istio/istiod 1.30.1 + istiod.yaml valuesObject -> 8 istio-reader lines (ClusterRole + ClusterRoleBinding); helm template istio/base 1.30.1 -> istio-reader-service-account present

test:helm template alloy grafana/alloy 1.10.0 -f Alloy CR spec rendered from k8s-monitoring 4.2.0 + current values -> ClusterRole k8s-monitoring-alloy-logs with 13 rules incl. core [configmaps, secrets]; identical to the live ClusterRole (kubectl get clusterrole, read-only)

test:kubectl read-only -> no secret labelled istio/multiCluster, 126 Secrets scanned with no multicluster label/annotation or reader token, 0 of 106 pods use istio-reader-service-account, 1 node, meshNetworks empty, istiod logs show no remote-cluster lines; live alloy-logs config.alloy has no remote.kubernetes and discovery.kubernetes uses role pod only

events.summary: Set global.enableReaderRBAC false in istio-base.yaml, istiod.yaml (inside the existing global map) and 09-istio-ambient.sh (istiod values heredoc plus --set on istio-base). Set collectors.alloy-logs.rbac.rules to the 9 upstream rules with the remote.kubernetes.* rule narrowed to configmaps in k8s-monitoring.yaml and 08-2-monitoring.sh. Pin both with R407 and R408.

events.scope: Static checks plus a pre-merge live trial on the local cluster (branch files pushed to Gitea with push-to-gitea.sh).
evidence: test:helm template istiod/base with the edited valuesObject -> 0 istio-reader objects (before: ClusterRole, ClusterRoleBinding, ServiceAccount); rest of the istiod render unchanged

test:helm template k8s-monitoring 4.2.0 -> Alloy CR spec.rbac.rules has 9 rules, none with secrets; helm template alloy 1.10.0 on that spec -> ClusterRole k8s-monitoring-alloy-logs keeps 12 of 13 rules, configmaps rule without secrets, clusterRules unchanged

test:live trial 2026-11-26: istio-base, istiod and k8s-monitoring Synced/Healthy after 10 min; istio-reader ClusterRole/ClusterRoleBinding gone; istiod 2/2 pods, istio-cni and ztunnel 1/1 Running with 0 restarts; ClusterRole k8s-monitoring-alloy-logs 13 rules with no secrets; alloy-logs 2/2 Running, 0 forbidden log lines; Loki devtools lines per 5 min steady 2000-3600 across the change (1 h query_range); test-sso PASS 144 FAIL 0

test:live: ServiceAccount istio-system/istio-reader-service-account remains, owned by the bootstrap Helm release istio-base (no ArgoCD tracking id, not pruned by ArgoCD); it has no RBAC bound and is not created on fresh installs; a helm upgrade of istio-base removes it

events.summary: Both values paths are changed in sync and the rendered RBAC is proven. Rollout behaviour (istiod and ztunnel health, ArgoCD prune of the reader objects, Alloy reconcile of the ClusterRole, Loki ingestion) is not verified here and must be checked in a live trial.
Complete within the stated scope (values, static pins, rendered proof); live rollout verification is a separate step.
